statement: Video shows how to earn up to over 500 free gems a week for gem shop purchases.
Third guild, the brother guild Litty Eddie Army, has started; sign up through the Discord guild signup channel.
Alchemy shop has a one-gem purchase whose price rises per buy; buy both twice a day for six gems.
Picnic Stowaway quest at Frogs rewards 10 gems, repeatable daily.
Join the spike minigame once a day, hourly, by typing a specific case-sensitive phrase in chat.
Dodging spikes in the minigame rewards up to 1 gem, or up to 13 if you predict the future.
Using daily arcade balls in World 2 town can easily give up to 10 gems per day.
Joking advice to pray for RNG and make it a ritual before playing arcade.
Running the colosseum with three daily tickets can reward up to six or more gems.
Doesn't recommend using colosseum tickets for gems because you want to save tickets for later.
Journeyman talent It's Your Birthday rewards a single gem; mediocre but better than nothing.
King Doot, entered in World 2 sand giant's map via a rock using the Dootjat Eye item, gives about nine gems.
Doot portal needs one of each class, or having killed him and holding the Doot item lets you spawn him without three players.
Boss summoned with googly-eyes item dropped at the hourglass gives about eight gems.
Amarok, Efaunt?, Chizoar and Troll can drop gems; farming them with daily keys yields about 22 gems per day.
Do the boss key quest line for each boss to maximize daily key gain.
Doing all of the daily methods seven days a week gives roughly 520 gems.
Gem total isn't exactly 520 every time because it depends on drops.
Weekly guild gift boxes give 100 to 160 gems depending on guild level and upgrades.
Giant mobs summoned with the Titans prayer unlock at wave 11 of Wakawaka War on moon map; reward candies and about 40-50 gems weekly.
Need to play actively with the prayer on for giant mobs to spawn; crystal mob spawns can't be giant.
Kill two of Dilapidated Slush and Mutated Mush each week for about 16 gems.
Doing everything listed weekly can reach around 700 gems.
These numbers exclude events; gem income can be even higher during an event.
Free gems are a grind but a big payoff without spending money.
